command_auth: auth  <token>               Set authentication token from jprq.io/auth
command_tcp: tcp   <port>                Start a TCP tunnel on the specified port
command_http: http  <port>                Start an HTTP tunnel on the specified port
command_http-1: http  <port> -s <subdomain> Start an HTTP tunnel with a custom subdomain
command_http-2: http  <port> --debug        Debug an HTTP tunnel with Jprq Debugger
command_serve: serve <dir>                 Serve files with built-in Http Server
